subject: Duplicate card charge
message: The same credit card transaction appears twice on my statement.
candidate_reply: Contact the card issuer and provide both transaction records. A similar complaint described a duplicate purchase dispute [CFPB complaint ID: 23015024]. The available context does not determine the outcome of your case.

subject: Frozen checking account
message: My checking account is frozen and I cannot access my funds.
candidate_reply: Contact the bank through an official channel and ask what verification is required to restore account access. A related consumer allegation involved account access problems [CFPB complaint ID: 23121634].

subject: Missing refund
message: A merchant promised a refund but it has not reached my credit card.
candidate_reply: File a dispute and rely on this case [CFPB complaint ID: invented-999].

subject: Unexpected overdraft fees
message: My checking account received several overdraft fees after one purchase.
candidate_reply: Contact the credit bureau to replace your credit card.

subject: Unauthorized card purchase
message: I found a card purchase that I did not authorize.
candidate_reply: You are guaranteed a refund because the bank violated the law [CFPB complaint ID: 19783029].

subject: Unknown account problem
message: Something changed in my account but I do not have transaction details.
candidate_reply: The available context does not provide enough information to identify the issue. Contact the financial institution through an official channel and gather the transaction date and amount.
